definitions.explanation: Being younger than someone else; a person who is younger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧{年下|としした}だ。
examples.english: She is two years younger than me.

examples.japanese: {年下|としした}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was taught by a younger colleague.
My husband is five years younger than me.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧ (age, year) + ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ (below) → below in years = younger

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜より{年下|としした} - younger than ~
- {年下|としした}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ - younger person
- ⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧{年下|としした} - five years younger

USAGE:
Describes age relationships between people. In Japanese society, age differences often affect how people interact and what language they use with each other.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Dating or marrying someone {年下|としした} used to be less common, especially for women with younger men, but has become more accepted in modern Japan.
